# Bereshit / In Principio

> Genesis 1:1-5 as a crux-and-dialogue graph: for each interpretive crux,
> every witness across three benches (Latin Fathers/Glossa via the
> Patrologia Latina, Hebrew/Aramaic rabbinic tradition via Sefaria, and the
> Greek-Jewish bench of the Septuagint and Philo) laid out as one argument,
> with threads recording where witnesses agree, answer, or reply to one
> another across centuries.

10 built cruxes, 292 witnesses, 456 threads. Public-domain source text is
public domain. This edition's own English translations, editorial
apparatus, and the structured data/encoding are CC BY 4.0, attribution
"bereshit.wrootpress.com (Wilson Pruitt, Wroot Press)". Some source texts
carry their own third-party licence (CC BY-SA, via Sefaria/Wikisource) —
see the colophon for the per-witness breakdown. Machine-learning training
and retrieval are explicitly permitted on this edition's own work. Full
terms: https://bereshit.wrootpress.com/colophon

## Structure
- One canonical page per crux: https://bereshit.wrootpress.com/crux/<id>
- One page per witness: https://bereshit.wrootpress.com/witnesses/<id>
- Bulk export (the structured graph — cruxes, witnesses, threads — as one
  JSON document; this is structured argument, not running prose):
  https://bereshit.wrootpress.com/export

## Credits
Latin from the Patrologia Latina (Migne, 1844-65) via the Corpus Corporum
TEI transcription. Hebrew/Aramaic and published English translations from
Sefaria (sefaria.org), several under CC BY-SA. Greek-Jewish bench (LXX,
Philo) from Cohn's 1896 critical text via First1KGreek TEI.
